<thought>The most intense peak is at m/z 180.0423, which in positive‑mode ESI corresponds to [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral mass of ≈179.0349 Da. Matching this exact mass to plausible organic formulas containing C, H, and O yields C₉H₇O₄ (calculated monoisotopic mass 179.0345 Da), which fits the observed isotopic pattern (≈10 % M+1 intensity for ~9 carbons). No other elements are indicated, so the formula is C9H7O4.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H7O4</final_answer>
